title: [Real WG] Autograph Session & Tea Time Episode
description:
[Real WG] Autograph Session & Tea Time Episode 

원더걸스가 'Like this' 앨범 이후 팬 사인회를 가졌습니다.
더불어, 티타임 이벤트를 가져 팬들과의 원더풀한 추억을 만들었습니다.
그 생생한 현장을 함께 만나보시죠!

Wonder Girls' had their autograph session after the release of 'Like this.'
They also had a special tea time event and made wonderful memories with the fans.
Let's share the excitement of the events :D
